notes.title: DEMO UPDATE!
notes.content:
[h1]Let's Cook Together 2 Demo Update[/h1]

Hello, aspiring chefs and culinary enthusiasts! We're delighted to present a sizzling new update to the "Let's Cook Together 2" Demo. Your appetite for cooking challenges has been heard, and we've been busy cooking up some exciting improvements. Let's dive into what's simmering in the kitchen:

[h3]Cutscenes[/h3]
Get ready to immerse yourselves into culinary repertoire with a selection of delectable new cutscenes! From shivering scenes from the future, to chill stories about cooking, everyone will find something to grind their gears!

[h3]Level editor[/h3]
That's right - you can create your own levels and play them. In the demo you can only create levels for the Polish cuisine and you cannot share them with the community - that is reserved for the full version when it comes.

[h3]Optimized level layouts[/h3]
We made sure, that while playing our game, everyone will be able to do their job, have fun, and cook. We follow the principle widely known in the internet: 'Let Them Cook!!!'!

[h3]New music[/h3]
The arsenal of music was extended with the climatic music of [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCD6PlNAXwu_snJXTYcUTj6Q]MINDSTEELNESS[/url]

[h3]Factory levels[/h3]
We heard you. We heard you loud and clear! Factory levels, more factory levels...

[h3]Experimental levels[/h3]
... or maybe it was experimental levels? To be honest, who hates those hard challenges (the spawn of our graphic designer imagination)? More of them! Release the hard puzzles on people!!!!!

[h3]Better UI[/h3]
We have updated many menus, buttons, and navigation elements to provide a clutter-free cooking environment.

[h3]Bug Fixes and Performance Optimization[/h3]
We've tackled pesky bugs and fine-tuned the game's performance for a more enjoyable cooking journey.

[h3]Proper credits[/h3]
We have updated the credits to include all the wonderful people who made it possible for LCT2 be created.

[h3]Bon appétit![/h3]

notes.title: Welcome to Poland - DEMO UPDATE

notes.title: Demo update - Chaos Mode now available!
notes.content:
[h1]Enter the Chaos[/h1]
[previewyoutube=rrNmlyhnDWU;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Update 0.4 brings the intense, unpredictable, and long-awaited Chaos Mode to Let's Cook Together 2! [/b]From inverted controls and spontaneous teleportation to invisibility and strobe lights, try to survive as the kitchens you thought you knew suddenly turn into crazy, mind-boggling traps.

[h2]Try it in the demo now:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1637400/Lets_Cook_Together_2/

[h3]Raise your hand[/h3]
With Chaos Mode, the "Gimme!" mechanic makes an introduction as well. Use it for signaling your position to other players. Just make sure you can catch whatever's coming your way.

Also in the update: 
- More intuitive tutorial;
- New teleportation effects;
- Better Prodigy controls;
and more!

Can't wait for your feedback on this one. Good luck! 

[h3][i]Full changelog:[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*]New game mode: Chaos Mode. Look for levels with antenna on the map and get a gold medal in them to unlock Chaos Mode.
[*]Added the "Gimme!" move - press B to notify other players where your character is on the screen (very useful in 3-4 player game)
[*]Added the New Stuff system - the camera now zooms in on new appliances and ingredients and shows a short description. This should make the starting experience even more intuitive.
[*]Added the New Content Popup – when entering the map the game now sometime shows a popup with newly-unlocked content (new chefs, new upgrades, new game modes, etc.)
[*]Upgraded the project to the newest version of Unity which gave us new possibilities (but also introduced new bugs to deal with)
[*]Much nicer chef teleportation effect (we created a custom shader for that and this alone required the Unity upgrade)
[*]Much nicer wall transparency effect (which we are very proud of as getting this kind of things set up in a 2D game is not an easy task)
[*]Retweaked the chef => appliances detection system - it should now guess the players intentions much better
[*]Chefs look much better on the chef selection screen (custom graphics for each character by Johan)
[*]Cleaning stains now has it's own small UI to show the progress o cleaning
[*]Added a "Resume" button in the Pause Menu
[*]Added a "Change Chefs" button in the Pause Menu - its a shortcut to use if you want to change chefs or add new players quickly
[*]Added a few new sound effects
[*]Restored the fire effect on the stove (apparently it was broken in the project for the past 6 months)
[*]Better progress UI colors - it should now be more clear when an appliance has finished its work
[*]Moving around the map should now be more intuitive (many small but important changes there)
[*]Added a Pause Menu on the map
[*]You can now set the vibration strength in the settings or switch them off completely
[*]The upgrades shop will now show only the appliances that you know and their order is more intuitive
[*]The upgrades shop will now work properly on wide-screens
[*]Many small optimizations for the Level Editor
[/list]

notes.title: Don't get burned! Update 0.2.6 available
notes.content:
[h2]Hi Beta Chefs, we cooked you an update![/h2]

After receiving tremendous amount of spot-on feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/Ncet73D5]Discord server[/url] (shout out, guys!), we introduced a handful of new features and tweaks to Let's Cook Together 2. Here's a rundown:

[h3]Don't get burned![/h3]
New burn mechanic puts some pressure on the serving side of gameplay. No more strolling around with hot meals – because now they're [b]HOT[/b], for real. So don't get too attached or they'll [strike]bite[/strike] burn. See how it works:
[previewyoutube=zh31ymjBAl8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Through the wall[/h3]
It's now easier to see which walls are blocking your food's path when serving/throwing. We're still tweaking the wall system, and with this change, we made things a bit more intuitive. 

[h3]Other notable changes[/h3]
We have also:
[list]
[*] Made a few mechanics less challenging across all difficulty levels,
[*][b] By popular demand[/b] - Introduced custom key bindings for those of you playing on keyboard,
[*] Added resolution selection,
[*] Added juicer sound effects. 
[/list]

Thanks again for all the feedback you provided on [url=https://discord.gg/Ncet73D5]Discord[/url] and in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1637400/discussions/0/3282569951983570082/]Steam Discussions[/url]. See you in a while!

notes.title: Let's Cook Together 2 Roadmap – see what the future holds
notes.content:
[h1]Check out Let's Cook Together 2 Roadmap[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42127725/210a90e031f33239fbbdccded9ab9640723a422e.png[/img]

So, what does all of this mean? Here are some details for Q2. 

[h2]Closed beta[/h2]
With the closed beta, you get the chance to play the game before anybody else – for free. The goal of the beta for us is to listen closely to you, the player, to help create the best experience possible. [b]It drops really soon.[/b] Click here to sign up:
[url=https://www.letscooktogether2.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42127725/2c6e9db7d6b0436b51b2001d5ed725890695bfe1.png[/img][/url]

Once the beta starts, you feedback will be invaluable. [b]So join our Discord to share your thoughts:[/b]
 [url=https://discord.gg/HXg8qjy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42127725/035d8562a14a9e803a0889033c398a7c7ab921f2.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Battle mode[/h2]
One of the most beloved features of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1271090/Lets_Cook_Together/]Let's Cook Together[/url], Battle mode is making a return in Let's Cook Together 2. Beat anybody you play against at the game of cooking food as fast and as smartly as possible. Whoever serves the most dishes, wins! 

[h2]More levels and mechanics[/h2]
The map grows bigger and denser each day, so expect to race time in dozens of new levels before the game leaves the beta! [b]We're talking about new kitchen layouts,[/b] new appliances, upgrades, and different character perks and cooking mechanics.

[h2]Comfy interior for the spaceship[/h2]
In Let's Cook Together 2, you travel the world onboard the Prodigy spaceship. Remnant of a distant past, it's your team's hub, playground, HQ, main menu, cafeteria, and the only safe means of transportation. [b]So of course it has to be cool and chill and comfy.[/b] Once the interior is all done and decorated, you'll love to hang out in there!

[h3]Wishlist and follow to stay updated[/h3]
Don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1637400/Lets_Cook_Together_2/]wishlist Let's Cook Together 2![/url]

More announcements coming soon 👀

notes.title: Let's Cook Together 2 is Coming Soon – Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-yt8G13ZVSA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]Let's Cook Together 2 is coming soon to Steam, and a Closed Beta is right around the corner![/b][/h2]
Set off on a cooperative journey to save the planet and its food from Nutri Inc. – a tyrannical food government seeking to turn Earth into a dry, tasteless dystopia. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1637400/Lets_Cook_Together_2/]Wishlist now if you haven't![/url]

[h2]Click to sign up for Closed Beta:[/h2]
[url=https://www.letscooktogether2.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42127725/2c6e9db7d6b0436b51b2001d5ed725890695bfe1.png[/img][/url]

[b]Let's Cook Together 2[/b] builds on the idea and the mechanics that gave birth to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1271090/Lets_Cook_Together/]its predecessor[/url], but [b]takes them to new heights.[/b] Literally. Onboard the Prodigy spaceship, you and your team lead a revolution to overthrow Nutri Inc, a bunch of crazy zero waste maniacs controlling the world. How? [b]By the power of cooking and cooperation, of course! [/b]

But there's much more to it. Let's Cook Together 2 is [b]the most ambitious project we've ever worked on,[/b] all the way from story and design to execturion. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42127725/68cd5ebc9d6aa9542fccc753af0a67425c1eaacc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Here's what you're in for:[/h2]
[list]
[*] From Italy to Japan, [b]free-roam the world[/b] and liberate regions, countries and landmarks all around the globe.
[*] [b]Visit dozens[/b] of challenging, wildly arranged kitchens to put your co-op skills to the test.
[*] Enjoy [b]tons of new mechanics.[/b] Cleaning, bumping into each other, operating futuristic appliances and much more are here to make each level feel unique.
[*] Choose the right chef for the job. Each of the characters [b]now has different perks[/b] that may make or break the experience.
[*] Get to know your team and feel the bitter taste of the future, as [b]a mature, full-blown plot is making a debut.[/b]
[/list] [i]And much more to come. [/i]

We're extremly excited to share more news with you in the near future. [b]Can't wait for you to save taste from the tasteless![/b]
